name: Dignitaire au masque sombre
description: A broad short adult chief in an original matte obsidian Yautja biomask with a broad vaulted forehead, an asymmetric bronze brow inlay and recessed small eye openings. Short thick dreads framed by one low bronze neck ring. Deep red pleated ceremonial robe with an engraved bronze chest medallion and a short segmented shoulder cape. Empty hands calmly clasped at abdomen; heavy compact silhouette.
